==== role=serve invocation=Combined tier=User ====
[Unit]
Description=Iroh Tunnel (serve)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart="/opt/iroh tunnel/bin/iroh-tunnel" serve run --config "/home/a b/it's & <cfg>/serve $$x%%i.toml"
Environment="IROH_TUNNEL_STATE_DIR=/var/lib/iroh $state%%n"
Environment=IROH_TUNNEL_SERVICE=1
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
RestartPreventExitStatus=6

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
